entry.title: First cohort of GenA.I. Sandbox++
entry.summary: Four Hong Kong financial regulators announced the first GenA.I. Sandbox++ cohort for controlled testing of selected agentic-AI use cases; participation is not an industry-wide obligation.

entry.title: Northern Metropolis Financial Advisory Taskforce holds its second meeting
entry.summary: HKMA and HKAB announced continuing work on financing models and risk mitigants for Northern Metropolis projects; this is a prospective commercial opportunity rather than a financing requirement or commitment.

entry.title: Employers' data in loan applications: PCPD findings
entry.summary: The Privacy Commissioner's Office found misuse of employers' personal data in loan applications and advised financial institutions to remain vigilant, without finding that a lender breached the PDPO or creating a new lender rule.

entry.title: First live tokenised-deposit transaction on Swift's blockchain-based ledger
entry.summary: HSBC and Standard Chartered announced a live cross-border tokenised-deposit transaction using Swift's blockchain-based ledger; it is market intelligence rather than a Hong Kong regulatory requirement.

entry.title: Implementation guidance on Banking (Capital) Rules
entry.summary: HKMA listed implementation guidance on the Banking (Capital) Rules for all authorized institutions, but the available evidence did not support a conclusion about changed calculations, thresholds, reporting or transition dates.

entry.title: Insurance Authority observations on premium-financing facilities
entry.summary: HKMA circulated Insurance Authority observations on insurance business using premium-financing facilities, but the available evidence did not disclose the observations, expectations, affected transactions or deadline.

entry.title: Mitigating risks in receiving deposits through simplified eDDA arrangements
entry.summary: The SFC expects in-scope licensed corporations and virtual-asset firms using payee-initiated simplified eDDA to assess authorization, identity, fraud, red-flag and indemnity risks.

entry.title: SFC early alert on UN sanctions-list amendments
entry.summary: The SFC expects in-scope securities and virtual-asset firms to update screening data following amendments to the UN ISIL and Al-Qaida sanctions list, while the corresponding Hong Kong Gazette update remained pending.
